observations: Black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'Fat' model design.
Top surface features a glossy Darth Vader graphic (Star Wars Limited Edition).
Two DualShock 4 controllers are visible on top of the console, appearing to be standard black or dark grey versions.
Sony logo is visible on the front edge of the console in photo 0.
The console is shown in a vertical orientation against a wall and floor.
The seller mentions 'pad' (singular) but two are shown in the photo.

claims.evidence: The origin of the console cannot be confirmed from a single photo.
The item in photo 0 is a PlayStation 4 console.
Photo 0 shows two controllers, which supports the claim of at least one being included.
There is no photo of the console's screen showing the installed games.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting up to the home screen and displaying video on a TV.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage Management' menu in the settings.

risks.risk: The 5 installed games may be tied to a personal account and inaccessible to the buyer.
risks.proof: A video showing the games launching without an active internet connection or external account login.

risks.risk: Controllers may have 'stick drift' or failing batteries.
risks.proof: A video of a controller test application or gameplay showing responsive inputs.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the system menu.
Screenshot of the 'System Information' showing storage capacity and firmware version.
Video or photo of the 'Library' showing the 5 installed games.
Photo of the model and serial number sticker on the back or bottom of the console.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Sony PlayStation 4 (Fat model). Sufficient market data for this model exists in the provided list to establish a price range, even when accounting for unproven claims.
